value: If the data submitted fails in any format level validation, an error response is displayed on the screen and the applicant shall rectify and re-submit.
quote: If the data submitted fails in any format level validation, a response indicating the error(s) will be displayed on the screen. The applicant shall rectify the error(s) and re-submit the form.

value: If there are no format level errors, a confirmation screen with filled data is displayed for editing or confirmation.
quote: If there are no format level error(s), a confirmation screen with data filled by the applicant will be displayed. The applicant may either edit or confirm the same.
